quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-11-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half of the FY to March 2026 (April-September 2025; orders, revenue, business profit and pre-tax profit are continuing operations, excluding Mitsubishi Logisnext): orders received JPY 3,314,713 million (+8.5% YoY) as Energy rose while Aircraft, Defense & Space and others fell; revenue JPY 2,113,717 million (+7.3%); business profit JPY 171,572 million (+2.1%); profit before income taxes JPY 173,720 million (+15.3%); profit attributable to owners of parent (continuing and discontinued operations combined) JPY 114,912 million (+7.3%). H1 R&D expense JPY 104,166 million, including JPY 70,583 million of contracted research

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-11-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Energy segment (H1 of the FY to March 2026): orders received JPY 1,981,278 million (+51.6%) on higher GTCC (gas turbine combined cycle) and nuclear power systems; revenue JPY 871,016 million (+4.7%) as GTCC and aero engines rose despite lower steam power; business profit JPY 80,793 million (-21.7%) as steam power fell despite higher GTCC
quarterly_data.figure: Energy orders received +51.6%; Energy business profit JPY 80,793 million (-21.7%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-11-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Other segments (H1 of the FY to March 2026): Plants & Infrastructure orders received JPY 490,656 million (-18.1%; engineering up, steelmaking machinery down), revenue JPY 415,953 million (+9.7%), business profit JPY 44,601 million (+58.6%). Logistics, Thermal & Drive Systems orders received JPY 292,817 million (-10.9%) on lower thermal products, revenue JPY 282,432 million (-7.1%) on lower thermal products and turbochargers, business profit JPY 7,600 million (+22.3%). Aircraft, Defense & Space orders received JPY 545,027 million (-32.1%) on lower naval ships and missiles, revenue JPY 538,832 million (+24.8%), business profit JPY 60,382 million (+37.2%)
